mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI increases are not followed by tighter monetary policy within the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to higher inflation expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE decreases below 5% are not followed by higher inflation within the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past 3 months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decreases are not followed by broader economic weakness within the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, the combination signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increases does not lead to tighter monetary policy within the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decrease by more than 10% year-over-year and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) also decrease by more than 5% year-over-year, the combined signal indicates a significant weakening in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decrease > 10% YoY and RSAFS decrease > 5% YoY
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of HOUST and RSAFS decreases does not lead to broader economic weakness within the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increases are not followed by increased consumer spending within the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) increases by more than 3% year-over-year and the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, the combination signals a strong supply-side expansion with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: supply-side expansion with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of INDPRO growth and low FEDFUNDS does not lead to sustained economic expansion within the next 12 months.
